meta.description: Gearbox Giants Central Single Source of Truth for Business Facts, Warranties, Pricing, Turnaround, and Locations

operating_model.logistics_model: Complimentary nationwide flatbed vehicle collection, recovery & doorstep return delivery
operating_model.service_coverage_label: 45+ Dedicated Regional Collection & Recovery Hubs across Greater London, Home Counties, South Coast, East of England & Midlands
operating_model.strict_terminology_rule: Use 'Gearbox collection and repair service covering [Area]' for collection hubs. Never claim physical workshop branches in areas where only vehicle collection/recovery operates.

warranty.terms_summary: 12-month unlimited mileage warranty covering replacement bearings, synchromesh rings, seals, gaskets, torque converters, mechatronic units, and precision assembly labour.
warranty.claim_procedure: Immediate diagnostic review and priority recovery to our engineering facility.

turnaround.diagnostic_inspection: Same day to 24 hours from arrival
turnaround.complex_or_rare_import_turnaround: 3 to 5 working days (dependent on bespoke parts supply)
factors_affecting_time: Transmission complexity (e.g. multi-clutch hybrid vs 5-speed manual)
Special-order OEM components or rare mechatronic circuit board supply
Dynamometer bench testing and electronic adaptation requirements
Customer approval of diagnostic teardown findings

inclusions: Complete transmission teardown and ultrasonic component cleaning
Replacement of all high-wear bearings, synchros, and seals with OEM-spec components
Precision re-assembly to original manufacturer tolerances

dealer_comparison.claim_statement: Up to 60% cheaper than franchised main dealer complete crate replacements
dealer_comparison.rationale: Main dealerships operate on whole-unit replacement policies charging £180–£250/hr labour plus new crate assembly margins. Gearbox Giants repairs and reconditions the specific internal failure components.

finance.terms: Flexible monthly repayment options subject to status
finance.regulatory_note: Finance options provided via approved partner lenders. Terms and eligibility criteria apply.
